  // Perform convolution

    window_strides = array<i64: 1, 1>,

    lhs_dilation = array<i64: 1, 1>,
    rhs_dilation = array<i64: 1, 1>,
    dimension_numbers = #stablehlo.conv<[b, i, 2, 3]x[o, i, 2, 3]->[b, o, 2, 3]>,
    feature_group_count = 1 : i64,
    batch_group_count = 1 : i64
  } : (tensor<6x8x6x6xf32>, tensor<7x8x3x3xf32>) -> tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>

  // Add bias: broadcast bias from [7] to [6x7x4x4]
  %bias_broadcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%arg1) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 1>} : (tensor<7xf32>) -> tensor<1x7x1x1xf32>
  %bias_broadcast_reshaped = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%bias_broadcast) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 0, 1, 2, 3>} : (tensor<1x7x1x1xf32>) -> tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>
  %conv_bias = stablehlo.add %conv, %bias_broadcast_reshaped : tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>

  // HardSwish: x * relu6(x + 3) / 6
  %three = stablehlo.constant dense<3.0> : tensor<f32>
  %six = stablehlo.constant dense<6.0> : tensor<f32>
  %three_broadcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%three) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 0} } : (tensor<f32>) -> tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>
  %six_broadcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%six) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 0} } : (tensor<f32>) -> tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>

  %x_plus_3 = stablehlo.add %conv_bias, %three_broadcast : tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>
  %zero = stablehlo.constant dense<0.0> : tensor<f32>
  %zero_broadcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%zero) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 0} } : (tensor<f32>) -> tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>
  %relu6_part1 = stablehlo.maximum %x_plus_3, %zero_broadcast : tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>
  %six_broadcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%six) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 0} } : (tensor<f32>) -> tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>
  %relu6 = stablehlo.minimum %relu6_part1, %six_broadcast : tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>

  %x_mul_relu6 = stablehlo.multiply %conv_bias, %relu6 : tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>
  %hardswish = stablehlo.divide %x_mul_relu6, %six_broadcast : tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>
